recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical heraldic composition featuring a central golden eagle with outstretched wings set against deep teal velvet drapery. The entire assembly is framed by a radiating sunburst of teal and white stripes, with a black arched banner across the lower third and a small bison icon at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance centered on the eagle and banner
Contrast between organic floral textures and rigid sunburst geometry
Color harmony between deep teal fabric and pale teal background rays
Hierarchy established by the large arched banner overlaying the central motif
coreInvariants: Central eagle with wings spread horizontally
Arched black banner with scroll ends
Teal, gold, and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main emblem is centered, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The golden eagle serves as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy black banner below it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central eagle, move down to the banner text, then radiate outward along the sunburst lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sunburst provides active negative space that directs focus back to the center.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background vs. low-value, high-saturation central subject.

letterConstructionRules: Internal decorative inline or 'western' style detailing
Arched baseline for the primary display text
High contrast between thick strokes and thin decorative cutouts
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-characters feature internal diamond or star-like negative space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary clean sans-serif or small-caps slab serif for metadata within the banner.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Western/Victorian slab serif decorative feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical heraldic emblem featuring a golden eagle with spread wings, resting on a bouquet of white flowers. The eagle is set against a backdrop of draped deep teal velvet fabric. The entire scene is centered on a radiating sunburst of teal and white rays. A small red bison icon is at the top center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black arched banner across the lower half of the emblem. Place large, decorative white slab-serif text along the arch of the banner. Add a smaller secondary line of teal text in a simpler slab-serif below it, flanked by four small gold stars.

verificationChecks: Does the eagle have a metallic gold texture?
Are the flowers white and leafy?

adjustableVariables: Number of stars on the banner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible and follows the arch of the banner
Check that the eagle does not look like a specific trademarked logo
Verify the teal and gold color balance is maintained
Confirm the sunburst rays are sharp and distinct
